publish-npm.yml:publish.reason: npm trusted publishing (OIDC) needs Node 22; the ts/web test jobs stay on Node 20, the laptop's version

deploy-mcp.yml:deploy.reason: wrangler 4.x needs Node 22; the ts/web test jobs stay on Node 20, the laptop's version

ci.yml:java.reason: gradle resolves dependencies over the network on a cold cache; make check allows no network (Makefile header); run cd java && ./gradlew test --no-daemon by hand

publish-maven.yml:publish.reason: runs on a java-v* tag push; release-check and the pre-push tag half gate it before the tag exists

publish-npm.yml:publish.reason: runs on a ts-v*/web-v* tag push; release-check and the pre-push tag half gate it before the tag exists

verify-go-release.yml:verify.reason: runs on a go/v* tag push, after the tag exists; the pre-push tag half runs release-check first
